# Dashi Animation Style

Turn a 15-60 second Chinese voiceover into a styled animated explainer video (1920x1080, 30 fps mp4 with voice and subtitles): every frame is drawn with HTML/Canvas code and captured with headless Chrome, no image model, with 7 built-in styles, new styles built from a reference image or a plain-language description, and a fully local Node, ffmpeg and whisper pipeline.
